title: Never Make Eye Contact
description: Avoid looking directly at passengers to prevent supernatural consequences.

passengerTypes: Lost child who doesn't realize he's been missing for decades

conditions.description: Distress high enough to turn hostile if ignored

tells.description: Passenger asks 'Why won't you look at me?'
Fidgets and glances repeatedly at the mirror seeking acknowledgement

exceptions.description: Lonely spirits need to be acknowledged, or their sorrow curdles into wrath.

followConsequences.description: You kept your eyes on the road and avoided the passenger's gaze.

breakConsequences.description: You met their eyes and your reflection twisted into a screaming void.

exceptionRewards.description: Reading them right steadies your own nerve.
You read the passenger correctly and earned a fragile trust.
A sliver of the passenger's story reveals itself.

title: Never Take Unscheduled Shortcuts
description: Stay on approved roads. Shortcuts pass through places that do not appear on any map.

conditions.description: Passenger's inner clock is running out

tells.description: Checks a watch every few seconds, knuckles whitening
Mutters that they need to arrive before something 'wakes up'

exceptions.description: Some passengers are racing an appetite. Get them there fast or become the meal.

followConsequences.description: You held the mandated route and nothing followed you off the map.

breakConsequences.description: The shortcut folded the road into somewhere older, and it did not let you back out.

exceptionRewards.description: Reading them right steadies your own nerve.
You read the passenger correctly and earned a fragile trust.
A sliver of the passenger's story reveals itself.

title: Obey the GPS Without Deviation
description: Follow the navigation exactly. The routing avoids roads that should not be driven at night.

tells.description: Pleads 'Don't take the highway - they use the main roads'
Shrinks into the seat and watches the mirrors when a highway sign appears

exceptions.description: This passenger is being hunted along the routes the GPS prefers. Deviate to survive.

followConsequences.description: You trusted the routing and the quiet back roads stayed quiet.

breakConsequences.description: You obeyed the GPS onto the highway and the things that use it found you both.

exceptionRewards.description: Reading them right steadies your own nerve.

title: Keep All Windows Sealed

conditions.description: Passenger is drowning in remembered smoke

tells.description: Gasps 'I can't breathe - there's too much smoke in here!'
Claws at the collar and the window seal

exceptions.description: The fire that killed her never ended for her. Crack a window or she relives it into meltdown.

tells.description: Keeps reaching for the window crank, eyes fixed on distant water
Insists the cabin is 'too dry, too still' without the night air

exceptions.description: The drowned fisherman calms only with open air on his face. Deny it and he brings the tide inside.

followConsequences.description: The seals held and nothing outside found a way in.

breakConsequences.description: You opened up for the wrong passenger and let the night reach into the cab.

exceptionRewards.description: Reading them right steadies your own nerve.

title: Maintain Complete Silence

conditions.description: Passenger is unraveling in the silence

tells.description: Begs 'Please, just talk to me - I can't handle the silence'
Whips around to check the empty seat beside them, again and again

exceptions.description: For these two, silence is where the paranoia wins. A steady voice keeps them anchored.

followConsequences.description: You said nothing, and nothing answered from the back seat.

breakConsequences.description: You spoke first, and something in the passenger answered in a voice that was not theirs.

exceptionRewards.description: Reading them right steadies your own nerve.

title: Never Stop the Vehicle Mid-Ride

Skin greying, a sheen of cold sweat under the streetlights

exceptions.description: When the distress is genuine, refusing to stop pushes them past the point of no return.

followConsequences.description: You never stopped, and the roadside shapes never got their chance.

breakConsequences.description: You pulled over at the wrong moment and the dark at the verge climbed in.

exceptions.description: Every tell screams that this deal is fair. It is not. The only safe move is to refuse.

followConsequences.description: You declined every offer and kept what was yours - including your name.

breakConsequences.description: You accepted the trade, and the fine print was written in something wet and permanent.

exceptions.description: He wants you to complete the song. Finish his contract's melody and it transfers to you.

followConsequences.description: You kept the music off and his contract found no new signature.

breakConsequences.description: You hummed along, and the deal he made for his talent quietly changed hands to yours.

followConsequences.description: You tuned her out and kept your future your own.

exceptions.description: Sister Agnes is the rare real thing. Her blessing is armor you'll want before dawn.

followConsequences.description: You declined, and refused a hook that never was one.

breakConsequences.description: You waved off the one true blessing of the night and rode the rest of it unguarded.

breakConsequences.description: You braked for a figure that wore a friendly face, and it was in the cab before it changed.

followConsequences.description: You kept your glances brief and never met the mirror's second face.
